ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are organized into high-frequency circular clusters across both lobes, with a large, mottled contiguous white region localized on the distal third of the right lobe; the medial region surrounding the notch is predominantly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by continuous, high-frequency serrations; a prominent rectangular-shaped notch/void is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a moderate convex curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, high-contrast white rings (cookie-cutter style scars) densely clustered across the dark pigmented sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of shallow, faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-medial section of the right lobe, cutting through the dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible clusters of barnacles (high-intensity, textured calcified masses) are present on the far lateral tips of both lobes; significant trailing edge trauma/indentation on the inner left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The high density of overlapping circular scars creates a uniquely complex, non-random texture pattern covering the majority of the low-intensity ventral surfaces.
